description: This file defines the ControlEventListener class implementing HttpSessionListener. It manages and logs HTTP session lifecycle events such as creation and destruction, and updates visit/session data accordingly within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ControlEventListener
classes.description: Implements HttpSessionListener to monitor HTTP session lifecycle events, manages session counts, logs session info, and updates related visit/session data.

methods.name: sessionCreated
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new HttpSession, increments session count, sets logging flags, and logs session creation info.

methods.name: sessionDestroyed
methods.description: Handles cleanup and persistence tasks when a session is destroyed: updating visit info, saving user login sessions, and logging session stats.

methods.name: logStats
methods.description: Logs detailed session and visit information, including session attributes, for debugging and statistical purposes.

methods.name: getTotalActiveSessions
methods.description: Returns the total number of active sessions.

methods.name: getTotalPassiveSessions
methods.description: Returns the total number of passive (passivated) sessions.

methods.name: getTotalSessions
methods.description: Returns total of active and passive sessions.

methods.name: countCreateSession
methods.description: Increments the count of active sessions.

methods.name: countDestroySession
methods.description: Decrements the count of active sessions.

methods.name: countPassivateSession
methods.description: Marks a session as passivated, updating active/passive counters.

methods.name: countActivateSession
methods.description: Marks a passivated session as activated, updating counters.

methods.name: getUserLoginSession
methods.description: Serializes the user login session data for storage.
